help.title: 🆘 Help section
help.about: ⚽ With this bot you can find stadiums, view available time slots and book online.
help.start: ▶️ To get started, send the /start command and follow the instructions.
help.booking: ⚽ Select region → stadium → date and time → confirm the booking.
help.payment: 💳 Payments can be made by card, cash, or both.
help.cancel: ❌ You can cancel the booking before the start time.
help.contact: 📞 If you have any issues or questions, contact the admin.
